business.name: Tranquil Escape Hair and Scalp Spa

evidence.observedFact: The business states that all packages require a booking deposit and that the deposit becomes non-refundable when an appointment is canceled without 24 hours' notice.
The business lists current Mentor contact information and hours and states that its hours are by appointment only.

A December 2025 News-Herald report says the spa was established in May 2024, describes personalized treatment plans and reports that the business was running a $10 spa-credit promotion for every $100 spent.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate appointment recovery and rebooking automation around the existing deposit and cancellation policy.
Build a permission-based comeback workflow that can extend the business's demonstrated promotional activity into repeat treatment visits.

notes: Booking requirements are observed from the business-owned website. The reactivation opportunity is a sales hypothesis informed by publicly documented promotional activity and repeatable personalized treatments; no monetary loss is asserted.
